purpose: Test the most direct global determinant compression of the remaining occurrence-consistency projection: keep the occurrence interaction matrix K as one unchanged port block and add an arbitrary fixed auxiliary matrix D whose complementary minors are supposed to implement the grouped equality weights.

grouped_boolean_sum.setup: Partition the occurrence ports P into g nonempty original-variable groups G_1,...,G_g, each of size at least two. For R subseteq P let b(R) be the number of groups intersecting R.
grouped_boolean_sum.coefficient_identity: Summing a rank-one occurrence determinant only over occurrence assignments that are constant on each group gives principal-minor coefficient c(R)=2^(g-b(R)): every group touched by R is forced active, while every untouched group remains a free Boolean choice.

forbidden_model.description: Choose any fixed square matrix D indexed by the occurrence ports P plus an arbitrary auxiliary set A. Embed the variable matrix K only into the P by P block, with zeros on all auxiliary rows/columns, and require det(D + embed_P(K)) = Q(K) for every K.
forbidden_model.strength: D may be fully dense and couple different original-variable groups globally; the auxiliary dimension is arbitrary. The restriction is only that K itself remains one unchanged port block and D is fixed independently of K.

theorem.name: NO_FIXED_AUXILIARY_DETERMINANT_REALIZES_GROUP_HIT_PRINCIPAL_MINOR_WEIGHTS_V1_1
theorem.statement: Over a characteristic-zero field, for every g>=1 with every group size at least two, no matrix D in the frozen fixed-auxiliary model satisfies det(D+embed_P(K))=Q(K) identically in K.
proof: The coefficient of the full principal minor det(K[P,P]) in the determinant expansion equals det(D[A,A]). The target coefficient is c(P)=1, so det(D[A,A])=1 and the auxiliary block A0=D[A,A] is invertible.
Take the Schur complement S=D[P,P]-D[P,A] A0^{-1} D[A,P]. Because det(A0)=1, det(D+embed_P(K))=det(S+K).

The target Q(K) contains only principal minors of K. For p!=q, the coefficient of the near-full nonprincipal minor K[P\{p},P\{q}] in det(S+K) is, up to sign, S[q,p]. Therefore every off-diagonal entry of S is zero.

For any port p, the coefficient of det(K[P\{p},P\{p}]) equals S[p,p]. Since the group containing p has size at least two, P\{p} still touches every group, so its target coefficient is c(P\{p})=1. Thus every diagonal entry S[p,p]=1.
Hence S=I. The constant coefficient of det(S+K) is det(S)=1.
But the target constant coefficient is c(empty)=2^g, which differs from 1 in characteristic zero for every g>=1. Contradiction.
theorem.field_scope: Characteristic zero, matching the exact integer/rational determinant route of v1.0. The argument extends to any field where 2^g != 1.

algorithmic_consequence.killed: The plan to compress the parity/equality projection by merely adjoining any fixed global auxiliary determinant gadget around the unchanged occurrence-interaction block K.
not_killed: nonlinear or formula-dependent transforms that change the embedding of K
constructions that duplicate/mix K while proving polynomial total size
other globally coupled invariants not expressible as det(D+embed_P(K))

next_target.name: E8_PARITY_NATIVE_PFAFFIAN_OR_NONLINEAR_CORE_TRANSFORM_V1_2
next_target.directive: Do not retry fixed auxiliary principal-minor reweighting. Attack the parity-subspace determinant sum with a representation that changes the core embedding itself, preferably a parity-native Pfaffian/matchgate construction or another simultaneous nonlinear transform.
success_obligations: no exponential tensor product over variable groups
